# Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the template dashboards that templates define for their hosts.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Id <ulong[]>] [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByName

```
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard [-Name] <string[]> [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard [-SortField <string[]>] -Id <ulong[]> [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByFilter

```
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard [-SortField <string[]>] -Filter <ZabbixTemplateDashboardGetParameters> [-Template <ZabbixReference<ZabbixTemplate>[]>] [-SelectPages] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template dashboard is a dashboard a template defines; each host linked to the template shows it with that host's data. The Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard cmdlet reads them with templatedashboard.get: all of them up to -Limit, by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards), by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole templatedashboard.get selection in -Filter. -Template narrows the result to the template dashboards of the given templates, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixTemplateDashboard objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get a template dashboard by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard -Name 'Web App overview'
```

Gets the template dashboard named Web App overview. A * or ? in -Name makes it a search, so -Name 'Web*' gets every template dashboard whose name starts with Web.

### Example 2: Get the template dashboards of a template

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard -Template 'Web App'
```

Gets the template dashboards of the template Web App. -Template takes a name, an id or an object; a template piped from Get-ZbxTemplate binds to it by its TemplateId property.

### Example 3: Search template dashboards with a filter

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplateDashboard -Filter @{ search = @{ name = 'Web' }; limit = 10 }
```

-Filter takes the whole templatedashboard.get selection, keyed by the API's field names: here at most ten template dashboards whose name contains Web.
